title: omaflake macOS base
description: omaflake-base.json in a macOS base folder (bases/mac-base-<build>/): the credential its guest user was created from or assigned – macOS image builds log in with its user and stored password.

credential.description: The credential's ID in config.json ("c-" and 12 hex digits)

credentialName.description: The credential's name when it was set
